description: This file defines a resolver class for configuring and managing the domain table in the OAuth2 admin UI of the Thingsboard platform. It sets up table columns, fetch/save/delete functions, and toggle actions for OAuth2 enablement and edge propagation.

classes.name: DomainTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An injectable Angular service that provides configuration for the domain table in the OAuth2 admin UI, including columns, actions, and data operations.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for the domain table.

methods.name: toggleEnableOAuth
methods.description: Toggles the OAuth2 enable state for a given domain and updates the table view.

methods.name: togglePropagateToEdge
methods.description: Toggles the propagateToEdge property for a domain and updates the table view.
